shots.p: wide shot of an ancient riverside village of mud-brick houses at dusk, its people busy and careless, while dark storm clouds slowly gather over the hills
wide shot of villagers of the ancient village gathered in the market square, some turning to listen to a warning carried on the wind, solemn overcast light
medium shot of a few villagers of the ancient village bowing in humble worship on a rooftop at dawn, abandoning carved idols lying behind them
wide shot of an hourglass on a stone ledge with sand running out, beyond it the sun setting over the ancient village, appointed time
wide shot of the ancient village shown at night then by day, lamps and sunlight, its houses visited door after door, persistent call
medium shot of villagers turning and hurrying away down a narrow alley, backs to the viewer, fleeing from the call
medium shot of stubborn villagers covering their ears with their fingers and pulling cloaks over their heads, arrogant scowls
wide shot of a crowded public square of the ancient village at noon, a loud announcement echoing over the crowd
medium shot of two villagers whispering privately in a quiet doorway at night, lantern light, a gentle personal reminder
close-up on the face of a repentant villager kneeling at dawn with upturned hands, asking forgiveness, tears and hope
wide shot of abundant heavy rain pouring continuously over dry fields that soak and shine, rolling clouds
wide shot of lush orchards and flowing rivers around the village, children playing and herds grazing, prosperous families
medium shot of careless villagers laughing and ignoring a vast thunderous sky above them, no reverence
close-up macro sequence feeling of a tiny seed becoming a sprout, a sapling, then a tree, stages of growth in soft light
low angle view of a vast clear night sky in layers of stars and galaxies stacked one above another, majestic
wide shot of a full silver moon glowing softly beside the glowing lamp-like sun at the horizon during twilight
wide shot of green plants sprouting from rich dark soil in spring, morning dew, life growing from the earth
wide shot of an old quiet cemetery returning to earth under grasses, then new sprouts breaking through the soil at sunrise
aerial view of a wide flat plain spread like a carpet, soft morning haze, gentle and welcoming
aerial view of wide roads and valley paths winding through mountain passes, caravans traveling along them
wide shot of poor villagers following proud rich leaders draped in gold, the leaders' wealth piled beside them, gloomy light
medium shot of rich elders plotting in a dim chamber around a low table, sly faces in candlelight
wide shot of five carved stone idols in a shadowy ancient temple, incense smoke curling, dim and oppressive
wide shot of crowds of villagers bowing before the stone idols, lost and confused in a misty temple
wide shot of a great flood of dark water swallowing the ancient village under a stormy sky, rooftops vanishing, no people visible
aerial view of an endless flood ocean covering the land completely under heavy rain clouds, a lone wooden ark on the waves
wide shot of the stormy flood horizon with heavy grey clouds, the old corrupt village gone beneath the water
wide shot of a small group of believing families stepping out onto green land after the flood beneath a rainbow sky, hands raised in thanks
